final: SELECT step4.ordersmark, step4.timespan, step4.avg_fillcount, step4.diff, step4.rnk FROM (SELECT step3.ordersmark, step3.timespan, step3.avg_fillcount, step3.diff, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY step3.timespan ORDER BY step3.avg_fillcount DESC) as rnk FROM (SELECT step1.ordersmark, step1.timespan, step1.avg_fillcount, step1.avg_fillcount - step2.avg_fillcount_overall as diff FROM (SELECT orderexecutions.ordersmark, orders.timespan, AVG(orderexecutions.fillcount) as avg_fillcount FROM orderexecutions INNER JOIN orders ON orderexecutions.ordersmark = orders.recordvault GROUP BY orderexecutions.ordersmark, orders.timespan) step1 INNER JOIN (SELECT timespan, AVG(avg_fillcount) as avg_fillcount_overall FROM (SELECT orderexecutions.ordersmark, orders.timespan, AVG(orderexecutions.fillcount) as avg_fillcount FROM orderexecutions INNER JOIN orders ON orderexecutions.ordersmark = orders.recordvault GROUP BY orderexecutions.ordersmark, orders.timespan) GROUP BY timespan) step2 ON step1.timespan = step2.timespan WHERE step1.avg_fillcount > step2.avg_fillcount_overall) step3) step4 WHERE step4.rnk <= 3
